sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Click on green at (44, 34) to select it
result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 44, 'col': 34}])
print(f"Clicked: board_changed={result.get('board_changed')}")

# Move it to frame at (44, 8)
# From (44, 34) to (44, 8): need LEFT 26/3 ≈ 9 steps
# Try 9 LEFT
result = action(['LEFT'] * 9)
seg = current_frame.segmentation
greens = {}
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'N':
        b = n['boundary']
        rows = [p[0] for p in b]
        cols = [p[1] for p in b]
        center = (sum(rows)//len(rows), sum(cols)//len(cols))
        greens[n['hash']] = center
print("After 9 LEFT:", greens)
print(f"level_completed: {result.get('level_completed')}")

# Check frames
print("\nFrame interiors:")
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'c' and n['children']:
        b = n['boundary']
        rows = [p[0] for p in b]
        cols = [p[1] for p in b]
        center = (sum(rows)//len(rows), sum(cols)//len(cols))
        child_id = n['children'][0]
        child = None
        for cn in seg['nodes']:
            if cn['id'] == child_id:
                child = cn
                break
        if child:
            print(f"  Frame at {center}: child={child['color']}({child['pixels']})")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
